tuning: Gen 6-9; native engine ability set, critical and recoil rounding retained
policy: Only effect_supported appended IDs may enter new roster learnsets. Unknown donor names must fail, never alias to HIT.

MOVE_ROCK_BLAST.reason: Already EFFECT_MULTI_HIT. Native 80 accuracy and native multi-hit distribution retained; no duplicate ID or retuning.

MOVE_SCALD.reason: Donor thawsUser plus Water-type target thawing require move-specific native support. BURN_HIT alone is not equivalent.

MOVE_DISCHARGE.reason: TARGET_FOES_AND_ALLY requires all-other-battler iteration. Native MOVEEND_NEXT_TARGET only iterates MOVE_TARGET_BOTH; PARALYZE_HIT is insufficient.

MOVE_LAVA_PLUME.reason: TARGET_FOES_AND_ALLY requires all-other-battler iteration. Native MOVEEND_NEXT_TARGET only iterates MOVE_TARGET_BOTH; BURN_HIT is insufficient.

MOVE_BREAKING_SWIPE.reason: TARGET_BOTH and ATTACK_DOWN_HIT are available, but donor metronomeBanned is not represented by native per-move flags or its fixed forbidden list.

MOVE_CLOSE_COMBAT.policy: Guaranteed attacker-only one-stage drops via script CERTAIN | AFFECTS_USER, not random opponent secondaries. Native Gen3 damage, critical probabilities, contact, Protect, Mirror Move, King's Rock eligibility and native ability set retained. Mist / Clear Body / White Smoke do not prevent these certain self drops. Miss, immunity, failure and Protect skip drops; successful Substitute hits and fainted targets do not block them; floors clamp. Punching classification has no native Iron Fist implementation or flag, so no modern punching-ability parity claimed. Native moveend and White Herb paths retained, not exercised by catalog tests. No Contrary, Simple, Defiant, Competitive or other absent modern ability behavior is promised. Headlong Rush uses explicit Gen9 120 power. Static C/data/script seam evidence only, no runtime or gameplay proof.
MOVE_CLOSE_COMBAT.animation_policy: Reused native animation, not donor animation parity
